kicker: Chashma bik gaya, customer saal bhar gayab
title: Ek saal baad *aankh ka number badalta hai*. Customer ko batao.
message:
Hi [naam] 👓 aapka chashma ab 1 saal purana hai.
Screen pe kaam karne walon ka number aksar badalta hai.
*Free eye check*: [din] ya [din]?
why: free check = koi pressure nahi. Number badla to *chashma wahin banega*.
caption:
